title: P-006 / AUTO-BAR-R-03-P-006 — current-cohort targeted L4 carry-preservation mutation proof

spec.behavior: Each supported engine preserves the configured SU runtime capabilities through a resumed PUI session.
spec.falsifier: Resume loses the assigned scope, modes, tools, task state or carry context on any supported engine.
spec.whyL4: The spec-test-adequacy lifecycle risk floor requires a targeted mutation or counterexample in addition to a passing end-to-end journey.

currentCohort.note: The binding server measures these exact file sets. No caller-computed fingerprint is used.

mutation.before: carry: saved.carry, modes: saved.modes, runtimeGeneration: saved.runtimeGeneration + 1
mutation.reason: R-03's falsifier explicitly names lost carry context. The ordinary installed-PUI journey launches with warm carry, resumes the same real OMP thread after a hard operator-process exit, and directly compares the resumed descriptor with the saved descriptor. Changing only the replacement runtime option keeps the native engine functional and makes the decisive assertion observe warm versus cold.

probe.command: PAPERCUSP_TEST_RUN_HARNESS=papercusp PAPERCUSP_WORKSPACE_ID=papercusp-workspace PUI_REAL_ENGINE=1 PUI_BIN=$HOME/.cargo/bin/pui PUI_REAL_BACKEND=omp PUI_REAL_ACCOUNT=auto PUI_NATIVE_ACCOUNT_CATALOG="$REPO/.papercusp/scratch/p006/account-catalog.json" npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/pui-e2e/agent-chat-pty.integration.test.ts -t 'restores the same native conversation after the operator OS process exits'
probe.modelPin: Intentionally omitted for OMP account=auto under plan Decision D-013; pinning PUI_REAL_MODEL on this backend is refused rather than substituted.

One baseline exposed an optional-model launch assertion defect; the next hit an OMP agent.db SQLITE_BUSY startup failure. Neither attempt applied or scored a mutant.

engineScope.caveat: This L4 row proves the shared installed-PUI journey catches lost carry on OMP. Binding 4238 separately records the completed Claude R-03 success run, but its test fingerprint predates the detector-only edits recorded here. Codex remains explicitly unevidenced and P-006 must not be reported complete from adequacy alone.
